title: Derived internal Hom for open extension and closed support
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion with complementary quasi-compact open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put $B_T=\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ for $T=X,U,Z$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived categories of $B_T$-module sheaves [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], their derived internal Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], the exact extension by zero $j_!$ [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek], coefficient-compatible inverse images $i^*,j^*$ [def-sfb-module-upper-star], and direct images $i_*,j_*$ [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. Define $Ri^!=R\underline\Gamma_Z$ using the support right adjoint of [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction]: on sheaves $\underline\Gamma_Z(N)=i^*\ker(N\to j_*j^*N)$. For every $L\in D(B_U)$, $P\in D(B_Z)$ and $N\in D(B_X)$, the adjunctions and evaluation give natural isomorphisms
$$R\mathcal Hom_{B_X}(j_!L,N)\cong Rj_*R\mathcal Hom_{B_U}(L,j^*N),$$
$$R\mathcal Hom_{B_X}(i_*P,N)\cong i_*R\mathcal Hom_{B_Z}(P,Ri^!N).$$
Here $i_*$ on the second right-hand side is exact direct image, and $Rj_*$ is total right derived direct image [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. All sites are small in the module universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The maps are natural contravariantly in $L,P$ and covariantly in $N$, and agree with the tensor--internal-Hom evaluation and the units and counits of these adjunctions. These are identities of internal sheaf-valued derived Hom, with no boundedness, constructibility, finite Tor amplitude, or invertibility assumption.

The open-immersion formula is the same internal-adjunction construction, using slice restriction of derived internal Hom, Stacks Tag 08JB (sites-cohomology-lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U), in literature/stacks-project/sites-cohomology.tex. proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-condensed-support-projection-formula] for invertibility of the two canonical tensor projections. Prove all four naturality equations directly from the naturality clause of [def-sfb-condensed-pullback-tensor-comparison], applying the open Hom adjunction and naturality of its unit, or naturality of the closed unit and counit. Invert the closed projection and cancel its invertible hom to obtain naturality of the inverse.

Apply [lem-sfb-projection-internal-hom-formal] first with e=j!, r=s=j^*, q=Rj*, and then with e=q=i*, r=i^*, s=Ri!. These use exactly the transported and support adjunctions of [def-sfb-open-closed-internal-hom-comparisons]. The two comparison maps are definitionally the evaluation-normalized maps recorded there.

Take asIso of the canonical closed projection and of both canonical Hom maps. Their hom equations are reflexivity. Apply the proven naturality theorem to the open and inverse closed projections for the simultaneous contravariant/covariant equations.

lean.statement:
theorem openClosedInternalHomFormulas {Z U X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ) :
    let := closedSupport_lowerStarExact Λ i j hij
    ∃ (p : ∀ (P : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ Z))
        (T : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ X)),
        ((derivedTensor Λ X).obj ((lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj P)).obj T ≅
          (lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (((derivedTensor Λ Z).obj P).obj
              ((supportPullback Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj T)))
      (o : ∀ (L : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ U))
        (N : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ X)),
        (((derivedHom Λ X).obj
          (op ((openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj L))).obj N) ≅
        (lowerStar Λ j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          (((derivedHom Λ U).obj (op L)).obj
            ((supportPullback Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj N)))
      (c : ∀ (P : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ Z))
        (N : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ X)),
        (((derivedHom Λ X).obj (op ((lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj P))).obj N) ≅
        (lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (((derivedHom Λ Z).obj (op P)).obj
            ((closedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj N))),
      (∀ P T, (p P T).hom = closedSupportProjection Λ i P T) ∧
      (∀ L N, (o L N).hom = openSupportHomMap Λ j L N) ∧
      (∀ P N, (c P N).hom = closedSupportHomMap Λ i j hij P N
        (p P (((derivedHom Λ X).obj
          (op ((lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj P))).obj N)).inv) ∧
      (∀ (L L' : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ U))
          (N N' : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ X)) (a : L' ⟶ L) (b : N ⟶ N'),
        (((derivedHom Λ X).map
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.map a).op).app N ≫
          ((derivedHom Λ X).obj
            (op ((openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj L'))).map b) ≫
          (o L' N').hom =
        (o L N).hom ≫ (lowerStar Λ j).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          (((derivedHom Λ U).map a.op).app
              ((supportPullback Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj N) ≫
            ((derivedHom Λ U).obj (op L')).map
              ((supportPullback Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.map b))) ∧
      (∀ (P P' : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ Z))
          (N N' : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ X)) (a : P' ⟶ P) (b : N ⟶ N'),
        (((derivedHom Λ X).map ((lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.map a).op).app N ≫
          ((derivedHom Λ X).obj (op ((lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.obj P'))).map b) ≫
          (c P' N').hom =
        (c P N).hom ≫ (lowerStar Λ i).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (((derivedHom Λ Z).map a.op).app ((closedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj N) ≫
            ((derivedHom Λ Z).obj (op P')).map
              ((closedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor.map b)))
lean.note: The existential families o,c are precisely the two isomorphisms. Their simultaneous morphism equations give full contravariant/covariant naturality. Their hom components equal the explicitly constructed evaluation/adjunction transposes. The auxiliary closed projection isomorphism p has its hom fixed to the actual unit-induced projection. supportPullback is identified with recorded upperStar by the canonical alpha scalar-transport isomorphism, without changing coefficients. Exact closed image uses mapDerivedCategory; the open image and support use total unbounded rightDerivedFunctor. Restored from the quarantine recorded in coord/rework.tsv. Closed termwise image is elaborated with explicit finite-colimit preservation; complementary-pair declarations install closedSupport_lowerStarExact in their types and proofs. The projection/evaluation formulas and dependency route are preserved.
